void handle_heartbeat(const mavlink::mavlink_message_t *msg, mavlink::common::msg::HEARTBEAT &hb)
		m_uas->update_heartbeat(hb.type, hb.autopilot, hb.base_mode);

notes: Opened snapshot:mavros/src/plugins/sys_status.cpp:619,629 and mavros/include/mavros/mavros_uas.h:128-131. The handler names the MAVLink HEARTBEAT message and reads its autopilot field. The getter casts an enum but does not state frame=none; absence of spatial meaning is not explicitly established by this citation.
